{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Calculate response rate for females and males in the treatment group only
# This is the most plausible interpretation of 'respond better' in a clinical trial context
females_treatment = df[(df['sex'] == 'F') & (df['arm'] == 'treatment')]
males_treatment = df[(df['sex'] == 'M') & (df['arm'] == 'treatment')]

response_rate_females_treatment = females_treatment['responded'].mean()
response_rate_males_treatment = males_treatment['responded'].mean()

# Compute difference in response rates
difference = response_rate_females_treatment - response_rate_males_treatment

# Convert to percentage points
difference_pct = difference * 100

# Print each number on its own line to ensure they are captured
print(response_rate_females_treatment)
print(response_rate_males_treatment)
print(difference_pct)"}
